findings.reason: without a usage-enumeration output in §4 (or a redirection of §3 to the §2 selector, which does parse a name's tokens), §3's done-when "every concept, symbol and pattern the §4 lint finds" is unsatisfiable.
findings.text: §3 states "the lint in §4 lists which concepts and symbols the 220 entries actually use, and that list ... is the authoring worklist", but §4 defines the lint as returning five classes of conformance findings and a per-class census, so nothing in §4 enumerates the concepts and symbols in use — a node building §4 to its own done-when produces no worklist and §3 cannot be started as written

findings.reason: §5's template rendering needs docs-opening-style and §2's location is settled by registry-home, so an unnamed "three" leaves a decision the downstream sections consume un-locked.
findings.text: §3's done-when says "The three decisions below are locked" while four decision blocks are declared (registry-home, fsa-canonical-form, plasma-boundary-gloss, docs-opening-style) and followup f-shs-001 says "bring the four decisions to the lead", so a node closing §3 cannot tell which decisions its gate requires and can close with one unlocked

findings.reason: the followup's resolution records that its work is carried here and its substance (pipeline.py:1964 sets audit_findings, no template reads it) is independently verified true, so the plan's §5 mechanism is right and only the status word is stale.
findings.text: §5 calls f-scai-audit-findings-reach-no-template "the open followup this plan inherits" but the followup carries data-status="resolved" (resolved 2026-10-12T05:11:52Z, outcome "Carried to sn-house-style §5"), so the citation names a closed node as open

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — every file, section and line anchor resolves (census doc, grouping §2/§4, pipeline.py:1964 confirmed to set audit_findings with no prompt template reading it), but §5 calls f-scai-audit-findings-reach-no-template "the open followup" while that followup is recorded resolved at 2026-10-12T05:11:52Z.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §3's done-when requires "the three decisions below are locked" while four decision blocks are declared, and the inherited followup f-shs-001 says "bring the four decisions to the lead", so the section's gate is ambiguous about which decisions it closes.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — no node directs evidence at a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path; §2's selector test, §4's census and §5's render tests are left to the repository's test/evidence convention rather than a transient path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — concepts.yml, notation.yml, templates.yml, lint.py and the conventions package are named by what they hold, and no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag appears in a symbol, filename or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §3 draws its authoring worklist from a §4 lint capability that §4 does not define; §4's lint returns only conformance findings (five classes) and a per-class census, never the "concepts and symbols the 220 entries actually use" that §3 names as its worklist.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each implementable section names one deliverable (§2 the registry, §3 the authored entries, §4 the lint, §5 the registry reaching the pipeline), and each done-when is a single coherent gate.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — plan-blocks names sn-harmonize-command and sn-west-prototype-release, both of which declare the matching depends-on (sn-harmonize-command#s4/#s5, sn-west-prototype-release#s3 in their plan-section-depends-on), and sn-catalog-audit-instrument carries status superseded and a comment naming sn-house-style as its successor.
